name: Party Data Search Criteria 2
definition: Set of search criteria for querying party reference data.

OpeningDate.name: Opening Date
OpeningDate.definition: Specifies the opening date of the party.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Specifies the closing date of the party.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type classification of the party.

ResponsiblePartyIdentification.name: Responsible Party Identification
ResponsiblePartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the party responsible for the maintenance of the party reference data.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the party within the system.

RestrictionIdentification.name: Restriction Identification
RestrictionIdentification.definition: Specifies the identification of a restriction.

RestrictionIssueDate.name: Restriction Issue Date
RestrictionIssueDate.definition: Specifies the date when the restriction for the party has been issued.

ResidenceType.name: Residence Type
ResidenceType.definition: Specifies the type of residence where the party has its permanent home or principal establishment.

LockStatus.name: Lock Status
LockStatus.definition: Specifies whether the party is locked or not, and the reason for this status, when required.
